detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

You don't need a phone system. You need three webhooks:
call.answered — who's calling, which number they dialed
transcript.turn — every utterance, streamed as it's spoken
call.ended — summary, recording, transcript, ready for your CRM
Wire them to anything — an n8n flow, a crew, a weekend Flask app. The phone network is just HTTP now. #VoiceAI #AIAgents
